name: Bacon Cheeseburger Egg-Bound Casserole
method: oven bake (egg custard poured over beef/bacon/cheese, baked to set)
why: Genuine egg-bound bake: 3 eggs + half-and-half + mayo custard poured over browned ground beef, bacon and cheddar, baked 30-35 min until set - the dish is defined by the egg/cheese set, not the meat. Published 536 cal / 32g protein / 2g carbs sits dead-center in the 400-650, <=35g band with high protein. Every ingredient maps to the board (ground-beef, bacon, onions, minced-garlic, pickles, eggs, mayonnaise, half-and-half, shredded-cheese). Scales linearly to 14 servings; distinct from the existing keto-cheeseburger-skillet (skillet vs custard bake).
